title: Chapter 149: Vulnerable
content:
Chapter 149: Vulnerable

"Attack!"

The attack range of the bronze crossbow cart is as far as 1 kilometer, so it can naturally shoot them.

Five spears flew out and directly stabbed three bandits to the ground.

Two spears missed.

At this time, the bandits rushed up with a roar.

They were not actually unprepared.

Many people were carrying flying claws.

This is a rope with a hook, but with such a high wall, they became live targets during the climbing process.

They were just bandits, just for money, but they didn't want to die in vain!

At this time, Wang Shuo's provocative behavior aroused their bloodiness, and many impulsive bandits rushed directly to the wall.

What greeted them was naturally a sweep of arrow towers.

In a few breaths, the first few bandits were stabbed into hedgehogs.

Others, seeing that the situation was not good, also stopped and withdrew from the attack range of the arrow tower.

At this time, Ayub's cavalry arrived, and a rumbling sound of horse hooves sounded.

The already messy formation of the bandits was immediately scattered.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed when he saw it, and it was indeed vulnerable.

"Let's go down and meet them too." Wang Shuo said to Gong Zheng and others.

With the cover of long-range firepower such as arrow towers, Wang Shuo was not afraid of being rushed in by bandits when he opened the city gate.

"Kill!"

A burst of shouts and killings rang out.

Wang Shuo and others also joined Ayub and started a cavalry charge.

This battle was a one-sided rhythm in the early stage.

It was beyond Wang Shuo's expectations.

He thought it would be a fierce battle, but he didn't expect that just a few rounds of charge would drive the bandits away.

"Don't let the opponent's generals run away!"

Seeing that the situation was over, all the bandits fled in panic.

Tekker naturally had no choice but to retreat.

But Wang Shuo would never let him go, after all, he might drop a certificate of general's job transfer.

Wang Shuo has been coveting the generals who have changed their jobs for a long time!

Wang Shuo and his men surrounded Tekar.

On horseback, there was no advantage in dealing with such a powerful general. A charge might even cut off the horse's legs.

So, everyone dismounted to fight.

"You can't escape. If you are willing to surrender, I can let you live."

Wang Shuo grinned, feeling indescribably proud.

It would be better if he could be captured alive. After all, the other party was a general. As long as he was controlled by the thought steel stamp scroll, he would be a real strength!

"Just you, beat the big knife in grandpa's hand first!" Although Tekel was surrounded, he was not panicked at all. It can be seen that he was very confident in his own strength.

He was not a reckless man with strong limbs and a simple mind.

Among this group of people, only the general holding the Qinglong sword and the man holding the big shield could pose a threat to him. He did not take the others seriously.

"No need to say more, let's talk about it after the battle."

Ayub took the lead in launching the attack, followed by Gong Zheng.

Wang Shuo did not consider the single duel, mainly because the opponent's level and strength were not enough to defeat him.

Tekker's level was several levels higher than Ayub's, and his attributes were not bad, especially his attack power, which was ridiculously high.

Wang Shuo, holding a spear, also joined the siege.

He thrust out a spear, which was easily blocked by the opponent, but Ayub's broadsword chopped into the opponent's shoulder.

After several attacks, Tekker was quickly defeated.

"If you surrender now, I can still spare your life!"
